# define and save transform: largest 8-connected component crop
src='''def transform(grid):\n    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]}\n    comps=[]\n    while pts:\n        stack=[pts.pop()]; comp=set(stack)\n        while stack:\n            r,c=stack.pop()\n            for dr in (-1,0,1):\n                for dc in (-1,0,1):\n                    q=(r+dr,c+dc)\n                    if q in pts: pts.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)\n        comps.append(comp)\n    comp=max(comps,key=len)\n    r0=min(r for r,c in comp); r1=max(r for r,c in comp); c0=min(c for r,c in comp); c1=max(c for r,c in comp)\n    return [[grid[r][c] if (r,c) in comp else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]\n'''
